checks.title: Likely Compromised Key Moves Funds From Safe Multisig via Zodiac | CoinMarketCap
checks.description: A probably compromised role key moved about 4.39M USDC and 1.72M syrupUSDC out of one Safe multisig via a Zodiac Roles module; no contract flaw was found.

checks.title: Safe Wallet Reportedly Loses $6.45M in Likely Key Compromise
